title: validateSvamlResponse
description:
Result of a SVAML validation request.

The HTTP `200` status indicates the validation was successfully performed — not that the payload is valid.
Inspect `isValid` to determine the outcome.

isValid.description: `true` if the submitted SVAML payload passed validation; `false` if one or more errors were found.

errors.description:
Validation error messages describing why the SVAML payload is invalid.

Present only when `isValid` is `false`. Each entry identifies a specific problem, including the affected field or command where applicable.

items.description: A human-readable description of a single validation error.
